slides.say: Given: diamond of three is equal to twenty-one. Which of the following cannot be the definition of the operation diamond?
This time there's no definition. They took three, did the diamond, and got twenty-one. [short pause] We'll solve it by plugging in three into each choice.
[short pause] The rule could be endless things. Seven x, for example, seven times three is twenty-one. So we look for the one that can not give twenty-one.
Choice number one, three cubed minus six, twenty-seven minus six, twenty-one. It can be the rule, out. Choice number two, three times seven, twenty-one, out.
at: It can be the rule, out

slides.say: Choice number four, eight times three minus three, twenty-four minus three, twenty-one, out.

Choice number three, five times three plus five, fifteen plus five, twenty. Not twenty-one, so this can't be the definition. Choice number three is our answer. In the exam, the moment you find it, mark it and move on. [pause] Okay. I'll see you in the next question.
at: Choice number three is our answer
